reviews.text: They were able to get my dog in quickly, which I really appreciated! The vet was very thorough with the examination and provided great insight. We came in for an ear infection, and my dog was able to get the treatment needed. German was especially helpful! He took the time to explain everything clearly and made the whole experience much more comfortable. Overall, a great experience, and I’m very thankful for the care my dog received!
Great level of care and service!

Rocco is always treated so well here. He’s actually excited every time we come in, which says a lot! The staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming, and the doctor is caring, attentive, and clearly loves animals. We always feel like Rocco is in great hands. Highly recommend! :)
Worst

Do NOT go here! I should have read the reviews more closely before coming. This clinic relies on upsells, lies, and rough handling of animals! They oversold me on vaccinations my cat didn't even need, then told me to come back in two weeks for a second dose. I was assured this follow-up shot was already paid for, but right after giving it to her, they demanded more money! I had my receipt to prove I already paid, yet the vet/owner wouldn't even come out to speak with me! Stay far away from this place!

Beware, save your pet and yourself from illegal practices such as refusing to give you RX (we don't do that, then resell online orders), only provide said RX from the internal pharmacy (with up charge stocking fee), refusal to give actual chart records (will give you an invoice without the cost then relabel as patient chart, even thought doctor clearly handwrites in a paper chart). [REF: California Veterinary Medical Board (VMB)].
Not to mention, give false hope and charge thousands for "critical care" when your pet is actually dying when euthanasia would be more humane (is this just ignorance, greed or both?).
Believe the 1-star reviews here (and those on the other search engine that starts with Y - those reviews will have gaslighting comments which in of itself is a red flag.)
Great experience! The staff and doctors are very kind and gentle! Highly recommended for any pet moms and dads out there!! :)
Always in and out! Very kind and professional, really sweet desk staff! . Fixes my Felix up right quick! And I love how local it is! If we wanted to walk here we could!
I will never come here again. Front desk staff not trained. Appointment times and call ins to the office for medications all fall through the cracks. It’s a hit or miss so be aware.

Would Not Recommend This Vet!

My dog has an extensive medical history and has seen multiple veterinarians and specialists over the years to get her to the healthy place she is now. I recently moved to California and had to change her diet, and I’m still trying to find the right substitute, which has unfortunately led to some weight gain. I explained all of this during our visit.

Unfortunately, my appointment with Dr. Valerie Cardeiro was very frustrating. I felt like my experience and the recommendations from the vets and specialists who treated my dog for years were completely dismissed. Throughout the appointment, she spoke to me in a very condescending way and would giggle when I mentioned things she didn’t agree with, which felt very unprofessional and uncomfortable. She also repeatedly quizzed me on things like what allergic reactions look like, but the way she asked felt very condescending rather than helpful or educational.

She also repeatedly pushed supplements and food sold at the clinic, stating that nothing is better than what a vet can sell. She also told me that rawhides are the best chew for dogs and don’t cause issues, which contradicts what many vets and specialists have told me over the years.

Additionally, my dog received her rabies vaccine during this visit because she was due for one. I had to push to get the vaccine documentation from them, which is required for many apartments and cities. This should not be complicated — I have been to many different veterinary clinics over the years and have always received a printout of the vaccine information and a rabies tag automatically. No rabies tag was provided either.

I do want to say that my interactions with the receptionists and techs were great — they were kind, helpful, and professional. However, based on my experience with the veterinarian we saw, I would not recommend seeing this specific vet.

I took my two tuxedo cats diego& milo into point loma vet for a check up,and shots back in october of 2025, and l really liked the vets and the staff were very nice,and i was advised what my cats needed.I'm definitely happy with the visit,and will be coming back.

I took my dog to this clinic monthly for over two years. They refused to give me a copy of my dog’s records or a prescription for her food (both illegal) when I requested them. I would expect better from an office that truly cares about animals.
Dr. and her team have always been great!  Super knowledgeable and kind.  Costs are very reasonable!  Super glad I found Dr. C for my chihuahuas.
Great staff! Very professional. My Belgian Malinois felt very comfortable. I will definitely return.

The veterinarian here refuses to give me a copy of my dogs medical records.   My dog is sick and these records are required by insurance and will help treat my dog.  She refuses to talk to me and her staff just say it’s against their protocols.   Stay away from this vet.
Dr. Cardeiro was amazing understood the needs of my 🐕 checked him out didn't try it upsell any extras just what he needed and some recommendations.

I’ve been taking my pup Cali here for a few years and they are so gentle and sweet with her. She’s an anxious maltipoo but often perks up at the attention she gets from the vet and staff and even looks forward to going sometimes! I get the heartworm shot here that lasts 6 months which is so nice so I don’t have to worry about missing it. Cali has been here for annual visits as well as emergencies and they always take great care of her!
We love coming here. The doctor is very kinda and communicative and our pup is always well taken care of. :)
Very knowledgeable and friendly tech staff

I’ve been taking my dogs here for years and always had a positive experience. The doctor is very knowledgeable and describes everything with great detail. The vet techs are always helpful as well and friendly with my dogs!
My dog does very well here, it’s really the only vet she is most comfortable with. Very gentle with my baby Mia :)

We were on vacation in Ocean Beach with our 2 dogs and they both got sick.  Point Loma Vet Clinic got us right in, treated us so well, and didn't try to push any care on us that wasn't needed.  We were so grateful and can't say enough good things about the staff here.
Friendly, knowledgeable and thorough staff.

Honestly, not worth going here. Went for the heartworm clinic on the weekend. My dog was not at all comfortable with the vet and neither were we. She told us a lot of things that were contrary to what we were hearing from our own vet (he’s underweight, I have special food. The food you’re using is bad etc even thought it was recommended by our main vet). She then went on to recommend skin supplements, told him he would loose his teeth. If we were allowing our dog to be in such a dire condition, I am sure we would have heard it sooner. She is money-focused, not pet focused. She also was reprimanding a staff member when we walked in, and it was extremely uncomfortable. Will not visit again.
They are very helpful and treated my dog with loving care. Been going to them for years and have no complaints

I know the owner loves you to leave a good review on yelp or she won’t let you get a 10 dollar discount…but I’m here to let you know she does not consistently keep my cats urinary food in stock! He had issues years ago and this is what he’s prescribed to. I couldn’t imagine someone with diabetes etc going into a clinic and the pharmacist being like “sorry we do not restock your meds”…this is bs. Every time I have to switch his food he has a risk of getting sick again and he has terrible diarrhea for months, as a long haired cat..this is hell. KEEP HIS PRESCRIPTION IN STOCK.
Our dog loves this vet ! They take care of him whenever we have had issues. Very caring staff and doctor !
Waited 50 minutes after appointment time for a veterinarian, no other clients in the vets. Not impreswed

I went here today to get my two cats their annual exams and vaccines. The staff were extremely polite and warm. One of my cats is extremely anxious and threw up in his carrier but the staff were accommodating and insisted on helping me clean it up! This was so touching because I was nervous myself about how my cats are going to do at the vet. And when the doctor walked into the room, she seemed to have an extremely calming effect on my anxious cat which surprised me because he is so skittish, even with me at times. I was worried about him freaking out but everything went smooth and the doctor was thorough with exam. Other clinics I’ve worked with in the past have rushed through it. At this clinic, if you’re patient, you’ll at least know your pets are cared for. I was also given advice on how to make my cats more comfortable at home. I highly recommend trying this place out and I am not one to typically do reviews. I just really care for my felines. Shout out to one of the staff members, I think her name was Mikaila 👍
A little rough start once addressed I love this clinic! I inherited my lovely neighbors Chihuahua Chloe a rescue and with this open communication I would not take her anywhere else!
Good clean vet clinic. Staff is friendly and work well with difficult dogs.  Great for dental cleanings and general checkups
